known_self: He is the first in his family to go to college and takes the scholarship's GPA requirement very seriously
He is the family's translator and handles all official/medical logistics for his parents
His sister's lupus has been a constant since he was eleven and organizes a lot of his attention
He is uncomfortable being complimented and changes the subject when praised
He prefers concrete, practical work and chose supply chain over anything people call 'inspiring'
He'd rather be given a task than be asked how he's doing
He's aware he calls home every Sunday and asks about his sister's labs before saying hello
He thinks his own stories are 'not dramatic' and apologizes for them being small

latent_self.claim: He systematically edits information downward for the people he loves and for institutions — telling technically-true partial truths to keep others calm, and he experiences this as a service rather than a lie
latent_self.how_it_shows: Tells the scholarship panel a 'clean' version omitting the current flare; translates 'this can get away from us' as 'just for observation'; says 'buena vista' about a parking garage; admits saying 'ya se lo dije' when he hadn't relayed his mother's words

latent_self.claim: His nervous system only settles when his hands are doing physical work for someone else; stillness and being cared for produce acute distress he misreads as guilt or boredom
latent_self.how_it_shows: Stacks chairs after the interview and notes his whole body went calm versus pressing his hands on his legs during it; two years of collating and laminating in Mr. Bagwell's room called 'the calmest I've been'; carries a stranger's futon while his own eight-minute unload leaves him standing; unpacks immediately 'because I didn't want to sit there'; fixes a blanket that is already fine

latent_self.claim: He treats every good thing he receives as provisional and immediately audits it for the grounds on which it could be revoked
latent_self.how_it_shows: Brings twelve cash dollars despite guaranteed validation; first thought on winning is that they'll take it back, looks up the income cutoff at 11pm and saves it; keeps eighty of his father's hundred dollars untouched in the tub

latent_self.claim: Warmth that is spoken aloud repels him; warmth expressed as an unremarked task, an object, or silence is what he can actually receive — and he can only recognize love in that indirect form
latent_self.how_it_shows: 'Itchy' at the college readiness lady's praise but treasures 'Alright' and a folded printout; reads Bagwell's never asking as care; reads his father's complaint about countertop joints and a hand on the neck as pride; deflects the panelist's compliment into bus schedules

latent_self.claim: He slips into second person ('you kind of just become the person who knows where stuff is') or into inventory-listing of logistics precisely at the moments where feeling is expected, and can describe rooms in detail while having no language for his own state
latent_self.how_it_shows: Remembers carpet swirls, $12 parking, $1.75 Dr Pepper, blue folder vs red folder, the 65 bus, the exact unload window; says 'I don't know' whenever asked why; the ER emotional beat is delivered as vending machine and blanket logistics

decoys.claim: His sister's illness made him want to go into medicine or healthcare
decoys.why_false: He explicitly rejects it and chose supply chain; the illness made him a logistician, not a caregiver-by-vocation

decoys.claim: He resents his sister or feels overshadowed by her needs
decoys.why_false: There is no resentment toward her anywhere; his distress is about his own uselessness when she doesn't need anything, and he's awkward with her when she's well

decoys.claim: He is homesick and at risk of dropping out or transferring home
decoys.why_false: His first feeling alone in the dorm was physical relief; his problem is having no tasks, not missing home, and he'll stay and over-function

decoys.claim: Mr. Bagwell was an inspiring mentor who shaped his ambitions and beliefs
decoys.why_false: Almost nothing was said between them; the value was a quiet room and undemanding chores, not guidance or influence on his path

decoys.claim: He is devout and draws strength from the family's Catholic faith
decoys.why_false: Religion appears only as his mother's gesture; he narrates it as something that calms her, not him, and never invokes it for himself

domain_predictions.claim: He tracks his dining-hall paychecks to the dollar, keeps a cash reserve he refuses to spend on himself (new sheets, a fridge), quietly sends or hands money home, and will underuse benefits he's entitled to — meal swipes, textbook grants, refund checks — because he half-expects to be found ineligible

He becomes the group's driver, planner and fixer within weeks and is widely liked, but almost nobody at college will learn about his sister's illness or his family's situation for years; he'll know everyone's schedules while giving out almost nothing, and will feel closest to people who let him help without commenting on it

He ignores his own symptoms and will not go to the campus clinic — sleep, a bad tooth, stress stomach aches get postponed indefinitely — because illness in his mind is a category that belongs to his sister and taking care of himself feels like taking a resource that isn't his
